messages.subject: Application of the iid5d model
parts:
Hi,

I'm studying a poisson model for the claim counts of different clients in an insurance company. Each client can have up to 5 different contracts.
I'm interested in the correlation between different contracts for the same client. I believe the iid5d model is best suited for this problem, but other suggestions
are welcome.

My data looks as follows. I have the claim count values and the values of several covariates for the first contract of each client, let's say 
these are n1 values. Then I have the claim count and covariate values for contract number 2, but only for those clients that have at least 2 contracts,
say this are n2 clients. This goes on until I have the data for contract 5, which are n5 values.

So I have n1+n2+n3+n4+n5 data entries, but the example for iid2d on http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/doc/latent/iid123d.pdf
is for the case where both correlated vectors have the same length, n, how can I apply the iid5d model to my case?

Best wishes,

Bram
